subject: Reschedule: Demo with Avatech - additional security & procurement stakeholders
messages:

To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@avatech.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + demo time

Hi Marissa —

Thanks again for the intro yesterday. We'd love to do a 30-45 minute product demo to see Redwood's latency/cost profile and understand how Dedicated/private deployments would work for us.

Our initial availability: Tue Mar 24 10:00 AM PT or Wed Mar 25 11:00 AM PT. Prefer Tue if possible.

Attendees on our side: me (Samir), Priya (procurement), and Victor (platform). We might loop in security after the first pass.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Engineering, Avatech
[Attachment: org-chart.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Shah <samir@avatech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + demo time

Samir — great, thanks for the quick reply. Tue Mar 24 10:00 AM PT works on our side; I'll send a calendar invite for a 45-minute demo and include a short agenda.

Agenda (proposed):
- 5 min intros
- 10 min product overview (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- 20 min demo + latency/cost highlights
- 10 min security/ops & next steps

If you'll be inviting security, happy to push the meeting later to include them — let me know.

I'll attach a one-page mutual action plan and a preliminary quote so procurement can review ahead of time.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: mutual_action_plan.pdf]

Subject: Re: Intro + demo time

Thanks Marissa — quick update: Angela (security) and Victor (platform) both want to sit in so we can cover encryption/KMS and network topology questions. Priya from procurement also wants to see the quote and MOP.

With the additional stakeholders, Tue the 24th will be tight for some folks. Can we look at Fri Mar 26 10:00 AM PT or Mon Mar 29 2:00 PM PT instead? Either of those would work better for the full group.

Samir

On a related note, Angela asked if you can share the SOC2 questionnaire and a short diagram of where data is stored during inference (cloud vs private).

Vivek, Laura, Monica — Avatech would like to include security, platform, and procurement in the demo. Their preferred times are Fri Mar 26 10:00 AM PT or Mon Mar 29 2:00 PM PT. Can you confirm availability? If needed we can also offer Tue Mar 30 AM.

Angela (cc'd) — I can share the SOC2 questionnaire and a short data-flow diagram. I'll also attach the mutual action plan and a preliminary quote so procurement has context.
